status_note: ActionDeindirect three-arm bilateral projection: constant arm with funcptr_align encoding-bit strip, COPY-chain walk, miss path, isOverride early return, noreturn-callee restart gate, external-reference arm, typed-funcptr forceSet arm. 6/8 cases byte-identical against the locked oracle; 2 cases are honest MISMATCH coverage of production-channel residuals (see coverage).

decisive_semantics.reference_output_parameters: Ghidra's apply mutates fc/op/override/Funcdata in place through pointers; Rugra's owner-Arc scoped guards reproduce the same in-place mutations. The fixture dumps read the same observable slice on both sides (opcode enum value, entry address, display name, count, restart delta, input lock, override flag, CALL arity).
decisive_semantics.loop_bounds_traversal_order: for(i=0;i<numCalls();++i) call-site index order; a conversion arm hit continues to the next site; the typed-funcptr arm is a plain if reached whenever neither conversion arm fired (including external-ref condition-true-but-query-miss).
decisive_semantics.counter_accumulator lifecycle: count += 1 exactly after each deindirect (cc:1237/1254) and after each forceSet inside the !isInputLocked gate (cc:1270); apply returns 0; the restart flag is Funcdata-global and sticky so the fixture reports the per-apply delta.
decisive_semantics.sorting_comparison_keys: no sorts; arm decision keys are the walked varnode's isPersist&&isExternalRef / isConstant; the constant arm's address key is addressToByte(offset, wordsize) then the funcptr_align double shift; lateRestriction's compat key set (model, dotdotdot, extrapop, inline|noreturn subset, effectlist) decides commit vs restart.

norestart_gate.covers: oracle fires restart via the db callee's noreturn bit; Rugra's db observable slice (default proto minted per call) cannot carry per-callee noreturn — the bit rides the flow-time callee_func_protos channel only (FLOW-NORETURN-DATA-0001). Corpus reach: 0 (TRIGFACE: both deindirect sites non-noreturn).

extref.covers: oracle resolves the ExternRefSymbol referral through the real scope; Rugra's Scope graph stores the exref symbol entry but not the per-symbol refaddr (Scope::add_external_ref returns the view, the scope keeps the base Symbol), so the production query detects but cannot resolve (= oracle newfd==0 behavior). Corpus reach: 0.
